Planet Labs helped Google build a small satellite to see how its AI chips handle the extreme
conditions of orbit.

carpooling on a rocket.

physical stress and temperature swings of space flight. Picture packing your
gaming laptop for a camping trip, where it is freezing at night and blazing at
noon, then asking whether it still works.
